rows.jyutping: hung3 zai3 m4 dou2 ge3 N
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice before a noun when something cannot be controlled, especially an urge, impulse, or reaction.

example.english: I have an uncontrollable urge to eat snacks.
example.traditional: 我有控制唔到嘅衝動，成日想食零食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 hung3 zai3 m4 dou2 ge3 cung1 dung6 seng4 jat6 soeng2 sik6 ling4 sik6

rows.note: Use this when a situation, emotion, crowd, or action has gone out of control rather than simply being difficult to control.

example.english: The situation at the scene became uncontrollable for a while.
example.jyutping: jin6 coeng4 jat1 dou6 sat1 hung3

rows.note: Use this for a person, animal, machine, or situation that does not respond to control.

example.english: This machine suddenly became uncontrollable and started moving on its own.
example.traditional: 呢部機突然唔受控，自己郁嚟郁去。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 dat6 jin4 m4 sau6 hung3 zi6 gei2 juk1 lai4 juk1 heoi3
